map.国家代码查询。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Country Code Lookup. An online tool built for developers, running entirely in the front end so nothing leaves your browser.
map.查询国家/地区的各类标准代码。: Looks up the standard codes for a country or region.
map.：E.164 国际电话区号（+86/+1）、国家顶级域名（.cn/.us）、货币: : E.164 international dialing codes (+86/+1), country-code top-level domains (.cn/.us) and currency codes (CNY/USD).
map.：表单国际化、地址校验、跨系统数据标准化。: : form internationalization, address validation and cross-system data standardization.
map.：部分代码已停用或变更（如 CS、AN），历史数据需做映射处理。: : some codes are deprecated or changed (such as CS and AN), so historical data needs mapping.
map.查 ISO 3166 数字/字母代码。: Looks up ISO 3166 numeric and alphabetic codes.
map.接口数据对齐：把各国名称统一成 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 代码再入库: Aligning API data: normalize country names to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes before storing them, so that variants like "United States / US / U.S.A." do not create duplicate records.
map.中国 → CN / CHN / 156；美国 → US / USA / 840。: China → CN / CHN / 156; United States → US / USA / 840.
map.海关/统计等固定编码，避免字母歧义。: Fixed codes for customs, statistics and similar uses, avoiding ambiguity between letters.
map.ISO 3166-1 只收录主权国家与部分特殊地区；台湾、香港、澳门按 ISO: ISO 3166-1 covers only sovereign states and some special territories; under ISO rules, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, China and Macao, China are listed under China. Some overseas territories (such as Guam and Réunion) appear in the list but are not sovereign states. Codes for historical countries such as Yugoslavia are deleted or reserved.
